method: Exact production controller helpers and notebook wiring; actual Canvas maps and input targets with minimal DOM adapters. Does not claim browser layout, native focus or WebGL validation.

checks.label: New guide belongs to the same atlas and exposes exactly twenty registered stops
Every stop selects its own camera and URL without modifying another notebook
Section opens from overview or reframes an indoor visit as a visible cut without changing water
Valid and invalid deep links resolve safely, including the initial no-WebGL path
Canvas fallback retains reachable targets on mobile and desktop, including each interior floor
Sources, thematic reading, keyboard tabs, map action and progress use the actual notebook wiring
Mobile guide uses shared half-screen layout and controls remain honest without WebGL
Leaving Grau restores its cut state and does not affect sea visibility
